Hi Renato, it's Dana. Great session today. You looked strong in the water. Okay, I've just spoken to the organizers, and the date is official: Saturday the twenty-second, at Margaret River. I've already sent the new schedule to Bev, so she knows about the early mornings. Have you put the date in your phone yet? Do it tonight. Now, tomorrow after training, we're going to watch the replay together. Bring a notebook. I've already watched it twice, and I've got three ideas for your strategy. One more thing. Your fitness is good, but don't train extra on the weekend. Rest is part of the plan. See you tomorrow!

Hey mate, it's Kai. Quick question. Have you checked the van list yet? I've just added your name, but there are only five seats, and Jess hasn't confirmed yet. Oh, and I've already booked a cheap campsite near the beach, the same one as last time. Also, Tom has just made a countdown on the club page. Ten days to go! Everybody's already talking about it. Have you seen it yet? Okay, that's it. Call me back when you get this.
